channel.title: Capital goods & infra · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.8).

item.title: [+1] Heading towards a landing point: EAM on US-India trade deal
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 26 reports from BusinessLine, The Economic Times, News On AIR and 18 more. Related: “India-US trade deal: Negotiations ‘heading towards a landing point’, says Jaishankar”. Turn: earlier readings (11 Oct) pointed the other way.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India will remain fastest growing economy in the world with 7% growth rate: IMF
item.description:
Signal: stronger Indian growth data (India). 7 reports from The Economic Times, Traders Union, NewsDrum and 4 more. Related: “Indian Economy – Nations Pride, World’s Envy! IMF Raises FY27 Growth Forecast to 7% Despite Global Oil Price Pressures And Rising Inflation”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Orders and capex firm

Why it matters: Better activity data points to firmer demand, orders and credit growth, supporting earnings across cyclical sectors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Jaishankar optimistic on US trade deal, China border talks
item.description:
Signal: easing global trade barriers (global). 2 reports from Open Magazine, Daijiworld. Related: “US Trade Deal Nears ‘Landing Point’, China Ties Need Stable Border: EAM Jaishankar”. Mixed: 2 reports point the other way. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — World trade recovers

Why it matters: Trade truces between major economies support world trade and demand for Indian exports.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1
